article.headline: Nuggets visit Jazz Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.description: Denver Nuggets (10-6, seventh in the Western Conference) vs. Utah Jazz (3-16, 14th in the Western Conference)
article.title: Nuggets visit Jazz Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.linkText: Nuggets visit Jazz Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.story: Denver Nuggets (10-6, seventh in the Western Conference) vs. Utah Jazz (3-16, 14th in the Western Conference) Salt Lake City; Friday, 9:30 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: The Denver Nuggets visit the Denver Nuggets in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. The Jazz are 3-14 against conference opponents. Utah is 0-2 when it turns the ball over less than its opponents and averages 16.3 turnovers per game. The Nuggets are 6-6 against Western Conference opponents. Denver has a 3-5 record in games decided by 10 or more points. The Jazz are shooting 44.7% from the field this season, 2.2 percentage points lower than the 46.9% the Nuggets allow to opponents. The Nuggets average 11.1 made 3-pointers per game this season, 1.3 fewer made shots on average than the 12.4 per game the Jazz give up. TOP PERFORMERS: Ace Bailey is scoring 13.3 points per game and averaging 6.2 rebounds for the Jazz. Darryn Peterson is averaging 18.1 points and 5.1 rebounds over the last 10 games. Nikola Jokic is scoring 24.6 points per game with 10.9 rebounds and 8.9 assists for the Nuggets. Jamal Murray is averaging 24.9 points and 4.4 rebounds while shooting 50.9% over the past 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Jazz: 2-8, averaging 108.7 points, 44.3 rebounds, 25.0 assists, 7.2 steals and 4.2 blocks per game while shooting 46.3% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 112.8 points per game. Nuggets: 7-3, averaging 117.6 points, 41.5 rebounds, 27.9 assists, 7.4 steals and 4.9 blocks per game while shooting 49.3% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 115.4 points. INJURIES: Jazz: Lauri Markkanen: out (wrist), Jusuf Nurkic: out (foot), Jaren Jackson Jr.: out (knee), Jaxson Hayes: day to day (knee). Nuggets: Julian Strawther: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
